parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
asset[ǽset]n.
An asset is a skill or quality that is useful or valuable.
→ The coach realized the boy's speed was an asset to the team.
😎
aspect[ǽspekt]n.
An aspect is one part or feature of something.
→ I thought about the different aspects of owning two dogs.
😎
Braille[breil]n.
Braille is a system of raised patterns on paper that allows the blind to read.
→ The boy enjoyed reading his favorite books written in Braille.
😎
bud[bʌd]n.
A bud is a part of a plant that turns into a flower or a leaf.
→ Two weeks after planting the seed, a small bud appeared.
😎
coordinate[kouɔ́ːrdənèit]v.
To coordinate things is to make different parts work together.
→ Each skating team had to coordinate their movements for the show.
😎
disprove[disprúːv]v.
To disprove something means to show that it is not true.
→ The scientist disproved the theory that the sun moved around the Earth.
😎
humanitarian[hjuːmæ̀nətέəriən]adj.
If something is humanitarian, it is connected to helping people's lives.
→ After the flood, several humanitarian organizations offered help.
😎
hypothesis[haipάθəsis]n.
A hypothesis is an idea for something that has not been proved yet.
→ The teacher did an experiment to prove whether his hypothesis was right.
😎
imprint[ímprint]n.
An imprint is an effect or lesson from an experience that is hard to forget.
→ The experience of war left an imprint on his mind that troubled him.
😎
informative[infɔ́ːrmətiv]adj.
When something is informative, it provides a lot of information.
→ The travel guide had a lot of informative facts about the region.
😎
optic[άptik]adj.
When something is optic, it relates to the eyes or light.
→ Her blindness was caused by a problem with her optic nerve.
😎
premise[prémis]n.
A premise is an idea on which something is based.
→ The premise of the movie that Bobbi and I watched was unrealistic.
😎
rack[ræk]n.
A rack is an object with shelves that holds things.
→ He stored his tools on a rack.
😎
Renaissance[rénəsὰːns]n.
The Renaissance was a period between the 14th and 17th centuries.
→ Leonardo Da Vinci was a popular artist of the Renaissance.
😎
revere[rivíər]v.
To revere something is to admire it greatly.
→ The students revere their teacher, who has taught them a lot.
😎
simultaneous[sàiməltéiniəs]adj.
When something is simultaneous, it occurs at the same time as something else.
→ The movement of the gears inside the watch was simultaneous.
😎
skeptic[sképtik]n.
A skeptic is a person who does not believe something.
→ The scientist showed the skeptic that dinosaurs did exist by providing evidence.
😎
spatial[spéiʃəl]adj.
When something is spatial, it relates to the position and size of things.
→ He was asked where the books were located to test his spatial ability.
😎
specify[spésəfài]v.
To specify is to describe something clearly.
→ The poster didn't specify where the concert was taking place.
😎
wax[wæks]n.
Wax is a substance that is slightly shiny and melts when heated.
→ The candles are made of wax.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: 1. informative
questions.explanation: "informative" mang ý nghĩa cung cấp nhiều thông tin bổ ích, đồng nghĩa với "helpful" (hữu ích).

questions.content: 2. coordinate
questions.explanation: "coordinate" nghĩa là phối hợp làm việc chung, đồng nghĩa với "to work together".

questions.content: 3. premise
questions.explanation: "premise" (tiền đề) là một ý tưởng (an idea) mà cái khác được dựa trên đó.

questions.content: 4. aspect
questions.explanation: "aspect" (khía cạnh) đồng nghĩa với "a feature" (đặc điểm, khía cạnh).

questions.content: 5. imprint
questions.explanation: "imprint" mang ý nghĩa dấu ấn hay hiệu ứng, đồng nghĩa với "effect" (ảnh hưởng, hiệu ứng).

questions.content: 6. rack
questions.explanation: "rack" (giá, kệ) là đồ vật để chứa/giữ đồ đạc, đồng nghĩa với "a holder".

questions.content: 7. optic
questions.explanation: "optic" liên quan đến thị giác/mắt, đồng nghĩa với "visual" (thuộc về thị giác).

questions.content: 8. Braille
questions.explanation: "Braille" là hệ thống chữ nổi (a system of writing) dành cho người khiếm thị.

questions.content: 9. bud
questions.explanation: "bud" là nụ hoặc chồi cây, đồng nghĩa với "sprout" (chồi/mầm).

questions.content: 10. wax
questions.explanation: "wax" là sáp, thường liên quan đến sáp ong ("bee substance").

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: 1. disprove
questions.explanation: "disprove" là bác bỏ, chứng minh sai. Trái nghĩa là "to validate" (chứng minh đúng, phê chuẩn).

questions.content: 2. revere
questions.explanation: "revere" là tôn kính, ngưỡng mộ. Trái nghĩa là "to disrespect" (thiếu tôn trọng).

questions.content: 3. humanitarian
questions.explanation: "humanitarian" thuộc về nhân đạo/con người, trong ngữ cảnh này từ trái nghĩa là "animal" (động vật).

questions.content: 4. simultaneous
questions.explanation: "simultaneous" là diễn ra đồng thời cùng lúc. Trái nghĩa là "preceding" (diễn ra trước).

questions.content: 5. Renaissance
questions.explanation: "Renaissance" là thời kỳ phục hưng (quá khứ). Trái nghĩa là "modern" (hiện đại).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: 1. We received humanitarian relief after I got a terrible haircut.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Cắt tóc xấu không phải thảm họa để nhận cứu trợ nhân đạo (humanitarian relief).

questions.content: 2. The boy waited for the Renaissance, which was going to start in the future.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Renaissance (thời Phục hưng) là một thời kỳ trong lịch sử, không thể diễn ra trong tương lai.

questions.content: 3. Alice placed the ball on the rack where all her sport equipment was stored.
questions.explanation: Correct. "Rack" (giá để đồ) dùng để lưu trữ thiết bị thể thao.

questions.content: 4. The woman liked the premise of the show, but she thought the acting was bad.
questions.explanation: Correct. "Premise" (tiền đề/cốt truyện) của buổi diễn.

questions.content: 5. The boy was scared by the simultaneous sound of the thunder and the phone.
questions.explanation: Correct. "Simultaneous" (diễn ra cùng lúc) của sấm và tiếng điện thoại.

questions.content: 6. The map was informative and helped them from getting lost.
questions.explanation: Correct. Bản đồ cung cấp nhiều thông tin (informative).

questions.content: 7. The teacher disproved her expectations. He did exactly what she thought he would.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Làm đúng những gì người khác nghĩ thì phải là proved (chứng minh đúng), không phải disproved (chứng minh sai).

questions.content: 8. Kelly had only met her uncle once and didn’t know much about him. She revered him.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Chỉ gặp một lần và không biết nhiều thì không thể "revered" (tôn sùng, kính trọng sâu sắc).

questions.content: 9. In spring, all of the plants in the garden are covered with tiny buds.
questions.explanation: Correct. Mùa xuân cây cối đâm chồi (tiny buds).

questions.content: 10. The skeptic didn’t believe that the magician could actually make someone disappear.
questions.explanation: Correct. "Skeptic" (người hay hoài nghi) sẽ không tin vào phép thuật.

questions.content: 11. He didn’t think about the aspects of smoking. Later he realized the disadvantages.
questions.explanation: Correct. "Aspects" (các khía cạnh) của việc hút thuốc.

questions.content: 12. The new hearing aid provides a wide range of optic choices.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Máy trợ thính (hearing aid) không liên quan đến quang học hay thị giác (optic).

questions.content: 13. The bad dream left an imprint on Jared. He had forgot it by noon of the same day.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Nếu để lại "imprint" (dấu ấn sâu sắc khó quên) thì không thể quên ngay vào buổi trưa.

questions.content: 14. He had to specify to the waiter whether he wanted onions in his food or not.
questions.explanation: Correct. "Specify" (chỉ rõ) việc có muốn ăn hành hay không.

questions.content: 15. The fruits looked real, but they were made of wax.
questions.explanation: Correct. Quả làm từ sáp (made of wax).

questions.content: 16. Her understanding has been a real asset in her successful career.
questions.explanation: Correct. Trí tuệ/sự hiểu biết là một tài sản giá trị ("asset").

questions.content: 17. I did an experiment to prove my hypotheses.
questions.explanation: Correct. Thực hiện thí nghiệm để chứng minh các giả thuyết (hypotheses).

questions.content: 18. Please use the spatial spoon to turn the eggs.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. "Spatial" liên quan đến không gian, không dùng cho cái muỗng (spoon) nấu ăn (thường là spatula).

questions.content: 19. Braille has helped many blind people enjoy literature.
questions.explanation: Correct. Hệ thống chữ nổi "Braille" giúp người khiếm thị.

questions.content: 20. If you coordinate all of sounds, you can make music.
questions.explanation: Correct. "Coordinate" (phối hợp) các âm thanh lại tạo thành âm nhạc.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Day Without Sight

On Friday afternoon, Sam’s teacher had a special assignment.

“Next week, we’ll be studying humanitarian efforts around the world since the time of the Renaissance, including those to help the blind,” she said. “Over the weekend, I want each of you to wear a blindfold for an entire day. The premise of this experiment is that it will help you understand what it’s like to be blind,” she said.

Sam was a skeptic. He really didn’t think the assignment would be too challenging. On Saturday morning, Sam took a piece of cloth and tied it around his head to cover his eyes. Then he went into the kitchen for breakfast. He heard the voices of his parents and brothers but couldn’t specify where each voice was coming from. He thought about how important hearing is for blind people.

“Could you pass me the newspaper, please?” he asked. Just then, he remembered he couldn’t see the words on the page. He wondered if Braille newspapers were ever made.

After finishing breakfast, his brothers asked him to play soccer. As he followed them, he accidentally walked into the baker’s rack. He also found that he couldn’t play soccer. He wouldn’t be able to coordinate his actions without being able to see. Without his optic senses, he had no spatial awareness. Furthermore, he couldn’t do simultaneous activities because he had to make sure he was safe first.

He sat on the lawn. Suddenly, he realized that though he couldn’t see, his other senses worked perfectly fine. In fact, he began to realize new and different aspects of common objects. For example, he took a flower bud and felt it with his finger. He realized for the first time that it seemed to be covered with wax.

His hypothesis about being blind was disproved. The informative experiment had an imprint on him. It showed him sight was an asset that should be appreciated and taught him to revere the talents of blind people.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: 1. Sam’s class is going to study humanitarian efforts since the time of the Renaissance next week.
questions.explanation: True. Giáo viên nói: "Next week, we'll be studying humanitarian efforts around the world since the time of the Renaissance..."

questions.content: 2. At first, Sam’s hypothesis is that the assignment is going to be difficult.
questions.explanation: False. Ban đầu Sam là người hoài nghi (skeptic) và nghĩ rằng bài tập này sẽ không có gì thử thách (didn't think the assignment would be too challenging).

questions.content: 3. When Sam goes into the kitchen, he reads a Braille newspaper.
questions.explanation: False. Khi xin báo, cậu mới nhận ra mình không thể đọc chữ trên giấy, và cậu chỉ tự hỏi không biết có báo bằng chữ Braille không.

questions.content: 4. Sam runs into the baker’s rack on his way outside.
questions.explanation: True. Trên đường ra ngoài chơi bóng, cậu vô tình đâm vào chiếc kệ bánh (baker's rack).

questions.content: 5. Without his sense of sight, Sam has better spatial awareness and can coordinate his movements more easily.
questions.explanation: False. Không có thị giác, Sam hoàn toàn không có nhận thức không gian (no spatial awareness) và không thể phối hợp (couldn't coordinate) hành động của mình.

questions.content: 1. What was the premise of the experiment, according to Sam’s teacher?
options: The premise was to help the students understand what it’s like to be blind.
The premise was to learn how to cook.
The premise was to learn to run.
The premise was to sleep in the dark.
questions.explanation: Tiền đề (premise) của thí nghiệm là giúp học sinh hiểu cảm giác bị mù sẽ như thế nào.

questions.content: 2. What did Sam realize when he couldn’t specify where the voices were coming from?
options: He realized how important hearing was for blind people.
questions.explanation: Sam nhận ra rằng thính giác (hearing) là vô cùng quan trọng đối với những người mù.

questions.content: 3. Why wasn’t Sam able to perform simultaneous activities?
options: Because he had to make sure he was safe first.
Because his parents told him not to.
questions.explanation: Sam không thể làm nhiều việc cùng lúc (simultaneous activities) vì trước tiên cậu phải đảm bảo mình được an toàn.

questions.content: 4. What aspect of the flower bud did Sam notice after he realized all his other senses worked fine?
options: Sam noticed that the bud seemed to be covered with wax.
Sam noticed that the bud was red.
Sam noticed that the bud smelled bad.
Sam noticed that the bud was cold.
questions.explanation: Sam nhận ra rằng nụ hoa (bud) dường như được bao phủ bởi một lớp sáp (wax).

questions.content: 5. After Sam’s theory was disproved, what was the impact the experiment had on him?
options: It showed him sight was an asset that should be appreciated and taught him to revere the talents of blind people.
It showed him he should never wear a blindfold.
It showed him how to read Braille.
It made him want to stay inside forever.
questions.explanation: Bài học cho thấy thị giác là một tài sản quý giá (asset) cần được trân trọng và dạy cậu biết ngưỡng mộ (revere) tài năng của những người mù.
